2607.21433.title: Token Budget Saturation and Mechanistic Early Detection of Reasoning Non-Convergence in Chain-of-Thought Models
2607.21433.paper_summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B exhibit a bimodal convergence pattern: generations either terminate within a token budget (converged) or exhaust it without reaching a conclusion (non-converged). We characterize this phenomenon empirically, showing that converged generations achieve 90.3% accuracy on AIME 1983-2024 while non-converged ones achieve only 6.6%, with an overall convergence rate of 62.0%. We then ask whether this outcome is detectable early in the thinking chain using internal model representations. Training linear probes on hidden-state activations at token positions 50-300, we find that layer-20 activations at token 150 achieve AUC 0.608 (+-0.080, 5-fold CV), reliably above chance even at token 50. Activation probes consistently outperform behavioral baselines derived from token entropy and repetition statistics. A sweep-level permutation test yields p=0.063 (100,000 permutations), consistent with a modest signal that our sample size cannot confirm at conventional thresholds. These findings suggest that convergence fate is partially encoded in intermediate representations well before the generation ends, opening a path toward early-exit inference and adaptive compute allocation.
2607.21433.paper_summary_zh: 鏈式思維推理模型如 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 展現出雙峰收斂模式：生成要麼在令牌預算內終止（已收斂），要麼在未達成結論的情況下耗盡預算（未收斂）。我們從實證上對這一現象進行了特徵描述，顯示已收斂的生成在 AIME 1983-2024 上達到 90.3% 的準確率，而未收斂的生成僅達到 6.6%，整體收斂率為 62.0%。接著我們詢問，這一結果是否可以在思考鏈的早期使用內部模型表示來檢測。通過在令牌位置 50-300 的隱藏狀態激活上訓練線性探針，我們發現令牌 150 的第 20 層激活達到 AUC 0.608 (+-0.080, 5 倍交叉驗證)，即使在令牌 50 時也可靠地高於隨機機率。激活探針始終超越基於令牌熵和重複統計的行為基準。一次掃描級別的置換檢驗得出 p=0.063（100,000 次置換），這與我們的樣本大小在傳統閾值下無法確認的適度信號一致。這些發現表明，收斂的命運在生成結束之前的中間表示中部分編碼，為早期退出推理和自適應計算分配開啟了一條途徑。
